lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Three long years of ash and iron. The Demon Lord's fortress lies in smoldering ruin behind you.

lines.speaker: Vargas
lines.text: Look at those golden walls, Commander. I can already taste the southern wine. Thirty years taking blades for the crown... I'm finally buying that orchard.

lines.speaker: The Hero
lines.text: You've earned twenty orchards, Vargas. We all have.

lines.speaker: Kaelen
lines.text: Squint at the parapets, Commander. Since when do royal welcomes post archers with notched war-bows behind the tapestries?

lines.speaker: Lyra
lines.text: Hush, Kaelen. The Sun Father guided our blades through the dark abyss. The King knows humanity owes us its very dawn.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The massive iron portcullis groans open. Bells toll across the High Citadel as you march inside.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Inside the Great Solarium, silver platters overflow with roasted meats and rare vintages. King Alden descends the dais with open arms.

lines.speaker: King Alden
lines.text: "Our savior! The Sun-Touched who walked into the shadow and brought back our tomorrow!"

lines.speaker: The Hero
lines.text: Your Grace. The demon is dead. The frontier provinces can finally sleep without fear.

lines.speaker: King Alden
lines.text: "Indeed. Peace is a delicate porcelain cup, my brave champion. It shatters so easily under the boots of a living god."

lines.speaker: King Alden
lines.text: "To the vanguard! Drink of the Sun vintage—aged fifty years in the vaults of the high lords!"

lines.speaker: Vargas
lines.text: To the realm, and to our commander!

lines.speaker: Lyra
lines.text: To peace.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The liquid burns sweet on the tongue... and turns instantly to black frost in your veins.

lines.speaker: The Hero
lines.text: N-ngh...! What... what is this...?! My limbs...

lines.speaker: Kaelen
lines.text: Hemlock... nightshade...! It's... poison...!

lines.speaker: King Alden
lines.text: "A realm can only wear one crown, boy. Did you truly believe I would let a squad of invincible martyrs walk my streets?"

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Iron boots thunder across the marble. Royal halberdiers emerge from behind the velvet curtains.

lines.speaker: The Hero
lines.text: Alden... we... we bled for your people...!

lines.speaker: Vargas
lines.text: Commander... get behind me...!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: CRACK! Three iron halberds punch through Vargas's breastplate. Blood splatters across the feast table.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The poison claws at your heart. Darkness swallows your vision as cold laughter echoes into the void.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Pain. Freezing, putrid mud. The steady percussion of cold rain on your face.

lines.speaker: The Hero
lines.text: *Gasp!* ...cough... haah... haah...! Where... where am I...?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You claw through rotting corpses, severed limbs, and maggot-eaten mud: The Charnel Trench beneath the palace walls.

lines.speaker: The Hero
lines.text: Vargas?! Kaelen?! Lyra?!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Beside you lies Vargas, his shield snapped in two, dead eyes staring hollowly into the rain. A spear is broken in Kaelen's throat. Lyra's prayer beads are soaked in blackened blood.

lines.speaker: The Hero
lines.text: No... no, no, no! Sun Father, hear my prayer! Let your warmth restore them! Take my blood—HEAL THEM!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You grasp at the sacred light that once crowned you savior, but the heavens remain deaf. The golden warmth has abandoned you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: In your agony, the power inverts—erupting as a blinding, freezing pale flame across the mud!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The white flame sinks into cold flesh. Bone knits to shattered bone. Ethereal blue embers ignite in their hollow eye sockets.

lines.speaker: Vargas (Spirit)
lines.text: ...Commander... our oath... is unbroken...

lines.speaker: The Hero
lines.text: Alden discarded us like refuse. But the dead remember. Rise, my friends. We are taking the Citadel.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: [Starter Deck Acquired: The Fallen Vanguard. 10 Cards added to your grimoire.]

lines.speaker: The Hero
lines.text: The scavengers at the trench edge are cleared. The road to the Citadel begins.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Pale embers illuminate the forgotten graves ahead.
